item.jujutsuvfx.gojo_teacher.use: Use on a normal cat: the blindfold descends and transforms it into Gojo Cat after 3 seconds.
item.jujutsuvfx.gojo_teacher.keep: Keeps its name, owner and age. Consumes one in Survival.
item.jujutsuvfx.purple.use: Use: release within 1s for small Purple, hold for large Purple; amplified hold casts 200% Purple
item.jujutsuvfx.blue.use: Hold to slowly extend up to 12 blocks; aim to steer at a fixed distance. Release for a short coast, then anchor. Lasts 10 seconds.
item.jujutsuvfx.red.use: Tap: Red orb. Hold: charged cannon. Collide with an active Blue for Unlimited Purple
item.jujutsuvfx.fuga.use: Use to form a fire arrow and release it after charging.
item.jujutsuvfx.dismantle.use: Use for a quick sweeping cut against creatures ahead. One cast per press.
item.jujutsuvfx.cleave.use: Release to slash; charge 0.6 seconds for eight rapid random cuts. Without Aeronautics, or with dynamic structures disabled, only ordinary blocks along the slash planes are destroyed. With physics enabled, charged cuts lock onto structures near the crosshair and scale to their size. Destruction follows administrator settings, with no drops.
item.jujutsuvfx.unlimited_void.use: Use to expand a domain. Default radius: 40 blocks. Duration: 5 seconds.
item.jujutsuvfx.malevolent_shrine.use: Use to expand a domain. Default radius: 40 blocks. Duration: 5 seconds.
item.jujutsuvfx.cursed_fist.aura: Energy ignites just before contact; Black Flash adds red flames and lightning
item.jujutsuvfx.cursed_fist.strike: Tap: jab, cross, hook, kick; buffer the next input during an attack
item.jujutsuvfx.cursed_fist.charged: Charged: the next successful hit releases the empowered strike
death.attack.jujutsuvfx.shrine_cut: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Malevolent Shrine
death.attack.jujutsuvfx.shrine_cut.playe: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Malevolent Shrine
item.jujutsuvfx.gojo_cat_debug_stick.tog: Right-click Gojo or Sukuna Cat to configure appearance, arms, hand energy and behavior.
item.jujutsuvfx.gojo_cat_debug_stick.hol: Cycle each energy: off, left, right, both. Toggle automatic combat preparation in the GUI.

gui.jujutsuvfx.gojo_cat.independent: Each energy has its own hands

gui.jujutsuvfx.config.title: Jujutsu VFX · Settings
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.lighting.hint: 0 disables lighting. Higher levels brighten and widen it. Default: 2.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.lighting.tooltip: Levels 1–5 use light radii of 1 / 1.6 / 2.2 / 2.8 / 3.4 times the original. Domain fill stays inside the domain.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.flashes.hint: Disable whiteouts and flash accents. Animated effects remain.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.flashes.tooltip: On by default. Off uses a smooth cosmic entrance and removes domain black/white cuts, Purple/Red white flashes, rapid Red flicker and explosion flash accents. Bright and animated effects remain.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.terrain.tooltip: Off by default. Controls terrain destruction, fire placement, physics assembly and cutting for players and cats. Independent of game rules; no drops. Only operators may change it.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.terrain.offline: Join a world to view; operators can edit.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.terrain.saving: Waiting for the server to save…
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.terrain.admin: This world · Operator editable · Default: off
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.terrain.readonly: Only operators can change server rules
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.cleave_physics.too: On by default. Requires Aeronautics and technique block destruction. When on, Cleave assembles and cuts dynamic structures. When off, it only cuts ordinary terrain and never creates, locks onto or splits a dynamic structure. Operator-only; affects players and cats.
gui.jujutsuvfx.mahoraga_cat.title: Mahoraga · Debug
gui.jujutsuvfx.mahoraga_cat.hint: Melee fighter · Rivals: Gojo and Sukuna
gui.jujutsuvfx.adaptation.title: Adaptation · Last 9 families
gui.jujutsuvfx.adaptation.reductions: Each hit adds 10% resistance to later hits, up to 90%
gui.jujutsuvfx.adaptation.hint: A new family replaces the least recently encountered one
gui.jujutsuvfx.adaptation.persistent: Saved with the world. No passive growth or healing.
gui.jujutsuvfx.adaptation.progress: %s contacts: %s%% less damage of this family. Sustained control counts once per second; nine contacts grant control immunity.
item.jujutsuvfx.mahoraga_wheel.use: Use on a normal cat to summon Mahoraga; use on Sukuna Cat to equip the adaptation wheel.
item.jujutsuvfx.sukuna_finger.use: Use on a normal cat: the finger descends and transforms it into Sukuna Cat after 3 seconds.
camera.jujutsuvfx.selected: Camera: %s · %s | F6 Exit · F7 Gojo · F8 Shot
camera.jujutsuvfx.missing: No Gojo cat nearby to follow
camera.jujutsuvfx.missing_other: No other kind of sorcerer cat nearby
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.cinematic.tooltip: On: automatic camera, scripted phases and Gojo loses domain clashes. Off: neutral cats, unscripted fights and random domain winners.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.unlimited.tooltip: Allow Unlimited Purple terrain damage as well as general technique block destruction. Default: off.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.music.tooltip: Play the supplied Rain Love DJ audio while viewing a scripted cat duel. Local preference only.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.music.volume.toolt: 0–100%; arrow keys change 5%. Also respects Minecraft master and music volume.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.music.hint: The score follows the cinematic camera: 2s fade-in, 3s fade-out, uninterrupted across shots. Also uses the game Music volume.
item.jujutsuvfx.playful_cloud.combo: Attack: sweep, reverse sweep, overhead strike
item.jujutsuvfx.playful_cloud.heavy: Hold Use to wind up; release for a heavy strike (0.8s)
item.jujutsuvfx.playful_cloud.physical: Physical cursed tool · Main hand · No terrain damage
item.jujutsuvfx.cursed_fist.derive: Hold Attack 0.5s: palm / after 1: uppercut / after 2: spin kick / after 3: barrage
item.jujutsuvfx.cursed_fist.air: Hold Attack in midair: ground slam. Two confirmed strikes charge Black Flash.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.damage.tooltip: Configure each technique. Saved by the server; operators only.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.title: Technique Damage · Server Settings
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.notes: Applies to techniques cast by players and cats. Sustained effects scale each hit, preserving charge and distance falloff. 0% disables damage. Unlimited Void deals no direct damage and has no damage entry. Scripted final executions remain independent.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.value.tooltip: Enter 0–1000 percent; 100 keeps original damage. The values below update as you type; Apply saves them.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.defaults.tooltip: Set every technique to 100%. Click Apply to save.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.back.tooltip: Return to settings; unapplied edits will be discarded.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.unavailable: Server does not support this feature, or no world is connected.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.ready: Operators can edit. Click Apply to save changes.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.readonly: Read only: operators can change server damage.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.unsaved: Unapplied changes. Click Apply to save.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.saving: Waiting for the server to save…
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.denied: Save denied: operator permission required. Edits retained.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.invalid: Every value must be an integer from 0 to 1000. Check all pages.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.failed: Save failed; previous settings restored. Edits retained.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.timeout: Server did not reply. Retry or reopen this screen.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.external: Server settings changed. Your unsaved edits were retained.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.reference.tooltip: Click to change the caster/target preview only. Player references include the mod's single-hit balancing, but exclude difficulty, armor, shields, defense, adaptation and the shared burst budget. Actual health loss can differ.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.blue: Per contact: player Blue normally hits every 0.5 seconds, cat Blue every 0.4 seconds.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.red: The range includes orb contact, terminal impact and cannon hits. Distance and mode affect damage. Cat cannon values are per hit; do not add every phase together.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.purple_sma: One contact per target. Small and large Purple share a damage basis but differ in size, reach and casting sequence.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.purple_lar: One contact per target. The cat's technique bonus against ordinary mobs is included.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.purple_amp: Amplified Purple already has its own damage basis. The input scales that basis, rather than amplifying ordinary Purple twice.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.purple_unl: Follows the server cinematic setting. Normal mode has separate player/mob damage; cinematic blast contacts use a 999 basis. Authored executions of designated cats remain independent.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.dismantle: Per actual slash contact. Visual blade counts do not equal damage contacts.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.cleave: Per actual slash contact. Entity damage, block destruction and physics cutting are separate.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.furnace: Range covers distance falloff from the blast edge to its center. Subsequent vanilla burning damage is excluded.
gui.jujutsuvfx.damage.details.shrine: Range covers focused and normal cuts against ordinary targets, per blade contact. Gojo Cat uses a separate %s HP basis at the current percentage, before defenses.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.title: Domain durations · Server settings
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.notes: Applies to the next normal player or cat cast. Active domains, clash timing and authored cinematic scenes keep their original timing.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.value.tooltip: Enter whole seconds from 5 to 120. Apply to save and synchronize on the server.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.back.tooltip: Return to settings; discard unapplied edits.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.unavailable: Server does not provide this feature, or no world is connected.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.ready: Operators can edit. Apply to save changes.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.readonly: Read only: only operators can change durations.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.saving: Waiting for the server to save…
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.denied: Save denied: operator permission required. Draft kept.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.invalid: Each value must be a whole number from 5 to 120.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.failed: Save failed; previous settings restored. Draft kept.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.timeout: Server did not reply in time. Retry or reopen.
gui.jujutsuvfx.domains.external: Server settings changed; your draft was kept.
gui.jujutsuvfx.config.domains.tooltip: Set both domain durations independently. Saved by the server; operators only.
